title: Froging AI: Free AI Video Generator From Text & Image
excerpt: Turn text and images into stunning AI videos with Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, MiniMax H3, and more. Start creating for free with Froging AI.
content_html:
Create Stunning AI Videosfrom Text & Images in Minutes

Turn a prompt or image into a video your audience will watch. Social ads, product teasers, explainers.

Powered by leading AI video models

AI-Generated Videos — Real Results, No Editing

Every video below was generated from a single text prompt or image. No filming, no editing — just AI.

AI Video Examples — See What You Can Create

Real outputs generated with a single prompt on Froging AI. No cherry-picking — this is what you get.

Turn Text Into Cinematic Video

Professional-grade video from a single text prompt. Describe any scene — product showcase, abstract animation, cinematic landscape — and Froging AI renders it with natural lighting, depth, and motion. No camera or editing skills needed.

Try It Yourself

AI Video That Moves Like Real Life

Froging AI runs on Veo 3.1 and Kling 2.6 — models built to understand real-world physics. Particles react to gravity, light reflects correctly, and motion has weight. The result: video that doesn’t look like AI.

Try It Yourself

Transform Any Image Into Video

Upload a photo, describe the motion, and get a video in seconds — no After Effects required. Add camera movement, change lighting, apply reflections. Our AI image-to-video engine handles the frame interpolation and physics so you don’t have to.

Try It Yourself

Explain Anything With AI Video

Turn complex ideas into clear, watchable video. Scientific processes, historical events, or abstract concepts — type it in plain English and Froging AI generates an accurate visualization. Ideal for course creators, science communicators, and social media educators.

Try It Yourself

What Can You Do With an AI Video Generator?

From social media to e-commerce to education — creators and businesses use Froging AI to generate videos faster than ever before.

Social Media Content

Create scroll-stopping Reels, TikToks, and Shorts in minutes. Our AI video generator turns a single sentence into a 9:16 vertical video ready to post. No filming, no editing — just describe what you want and download.

Product Demos & Ads

Upload a product photo and let AI turn it into a 360° showcase or lifestyle video. Perfect for e-commerce listings, ad creatives, and landing page hero videos. Our AI image to video tool handles the animation — you focus on selling.

Marketing Campaigns

Generate multiple video variations from one brief. Test different styles, camera angles, and moods without reshooting anything. Our AI video generator lets you A/B test creatives as easily as writing a prompt.

Educational & Explainer Videos

Turn complex topics into clear, engaging visual explanations. From scientific processes to historical events, our AI video generator creates accurate animations from text descriptions — ideal for courses, presentations, and tutorials.

Creative Storytelling

Bring your creative vision to life without a production crew. Generate cinematic scenes, surreal visual effects, and animated shorts — all from a text prompt. Our AI text to video generator gives filmmakers and artists an infinite canvas.

AI Video Generator Features — No Watermark, HD Output, Start for Free

AI Video Models — Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, MiniMax H3 & More

Most AI video tools lock you into one model. Froging AI brings leading models such as Kling 3.0, Google Veo 3.1, MiniMax H3, Wan 2.7, and Seedance 2.0 into one workspace, each with distinct strengths in motion, detail, speed, and audio. Switch freely to find the best fit for each scene.

Kling 3.0Veo 3.1MiniMax H3Seedance 2.0

AI Text to Video — Turn Words Into Stunning Videos

Describe any scene in plain English and watch it come to life in seconds. No editing skills needed — our AI text to video generator handles everything from camera movement to lighting.

Describe Your Vision

Type what you want to see — a golden-hour cityscape, a slow-motion kickflip, or a surreal dreamscape. Our AI understands complex scenes, cinematic styles, and natural motion. The more detail you give, the more stunning the result.

Choose Your AI Model

Switch between leading models such as Kling 3.0, Veo 3.1, MiniMax H3, Wan 2.7, and Seedance 2.0. Each model has distinct strengths in realism, motion, detail, speed, and audio — try them and find the best fit for your scene.

Generate & Download

Hit generate and your HD video is ready in under a minute. Download instantly with zero watermarks. Use it for social media, ads, presentations — whatever you need. Paid plans include full commercial rights.

AI Image to Video — Bring Any Photo to Life

Upload a single image and let AI transform it into a smooth, cinematic video. Animate portraits, product shots, landscapes, or artwork — no video editing skills required.

Drop Any Image

Upload a portrait for a talking-head video, a product photo for a 360° showcase, or a landscape for a cinematic flyover. Our AI image to video generator supports JPG, PNG, and WebP — just drag and drop.

Guide the Motion

Want the camera to zoom in slowly? Or add a wind effect to hair? Just type it in plain English. Our AI understands natural motion descriptions and applies them while keeping your original image intact.

Export in HD, No Watermark

Get smooth 720P or 1080P video output ready for Instagram Reels, TikTok, YouTube, or client presentations. Every download is watermark-free. Paid plans include full commercial rights — no hidden fees, no fine print.

Pick Your Plan to Get Started

Generate professional AI videos — ready for TikTok, Reels, ads, and creative projects.
